observations.registry_first: Current 000014 adopted the empty reservation. Rolling back the empty queue restored the reservation and left enrollment storage in place. Explicitly reapplying 000014 succeeded with Ecto's out-of-order version warning.
observations.publication: Two registered targets with separate restricted writer logins ran the ordinary publication service, published sequence 8, and replayed their requests with one job per exact reference. A signed sequence-9 rollback also replayed with one job.
observations.processing: The ordinary releases_v1 processor projected the exact signed bytes, digest, rollout, and action from each immutable ledger row. The unchanged operator script repaired the discarded Android job by ID exactly once and it completed on the next attempt. The iOS sequence-8 job completed on its first attempt.
observations.delivery_and_cleanup: The exact signed rollback and historical artifact were served through ordinary Phoenix. Existing enrollment and root revocation checks passed. Queue rollback refused retained jobs. Each replay released the owned PostgreSQL cluster and scratch.
